cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Approve the Cover Story
cards.instruction: Get someone to endorse an explanation that protects the plan, reputation, or people involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've settled on 'collecting chairs' for why we opened the props cupboard. You'll back me; we need the caretaker to lend us the hall again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: May I point out chairs don't fit in there?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Correction approved. 'Checking for folding stools.' You may endorse that version.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you admit you borrowed his key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your condition is accepted. 'Borrowed the key to check for extra seating.' Sign the hall request beside me; I approve a united account.
